title.zh: Predict Fun users lose $260K in ‘likely’ ongoing draining incident
title.en: Predict Fun users lose $260K in ‘likely’ ongoing draining incident

current_state.zh: Predict Fun, a BNB-based prediction market founded by former Binance staff, is suffering a likely ongoing draining attack in which at least 19 victims have lost about 105 ETH (~$260K), with the stolen funds bridged to Ethereum and sent through Tornado Cash.
current_state.en: Predict Fun, a BNB-based prediction market founded by former Binance staff, is suffering a likely ongoing draining attack in which at least 19 victims have lost about 105 ETH (~$260K), with the stolen funds bridged to Ethereum and sent through Tornado Cash.
